messages.content_text:
june 25 Notes:


I did not take a trade today because it was the day after passing my funded and that is a big thing to deal with emotionally, so I used the day to tape read and practice market knowledge.
,
Coming into the day, I knew that we were most likely going to be bearish because in am pre session, we had an amd model where we tapped the ce of the daily bearish fvg, rejected off of it, and sure enough when market opened at 9:30 it dumped. We also had a huge volume imbalance on the daily timeframe and I wanted to see a close below that today, which we also saw, and what also added to my bearish bias. (Screenshot 1)
,
10:00 kind of provided an entry today, but there was was one big flaw that would have made me fade this winning trade. Price traded down and at 9:59 we tapped the ce of the 4h bullish rb at the bottom of the range. The next candle (10:00) created a strong bullish displacement and made a cisd leaving for a good entry at 10:01. We also had an smt at the 4h low. This is my model, htf pd array, entry trigger, multiple confluences, but the problem is that we barely had any amount of manipulation below 10:00. That would be a good enough reason to fade this setup for me. (Screenshot 2)
,
Had a good read today and a good reason not to trade, so I am definitely happy with how the day turned out
,
